_doc: GENERATED by scripts/build-ced-column-titles.mjs -- do not edit. Schoology column titles, OLD (what the sync names columns today) -> CED-2026. Keys are the sync column keys. CED2026_SINGLE_SOURCE_SPEC.md section 3.
rules: Suffix by kind: lesson -> "Follow-Along", quiz -> "Quiz", blooket -> "Blooket".
One CED topic, whole topic covered -> "<topic> <Suffix>" (e.g. "1.11 Follow-Along").
One CED topic shared by several old lessons, column covers part -> "<topic> Day <n> <Suffix>" (Day = the Desk calendar day, cedLabel().day; several days -> "Days a-b").
Several CED topics -> consecutive runs "a-b", other runs joined " + "; no Day (e.g. "2.4-2.6 Follow-Along").
Bonus (Beyond the Exam) topics inside a core column are dropped from the title (flagged).
All-bonus column -> "Beyond the Exam: <label without the parenthetical>[ Day n] <Suffix>".
Progress Check / Poster: "Unit <new unit> Progress Check" / "Unit <new unit> Poster" (unchanged).

Plain ASCII only (hyphen "-", never an en dash) and never ", ": the sync finds a column by matching ", <title>" inside the gradebook cell aria-label, so a comma-space would let "3.3 Quiz" match "2.4, 3.3 Quiz".
Every real column has a unique CED title (asserted at build time).
schoologyColumn false = lesson-granularity topic key inside a combined worksheet; never a real column.
